mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 3.5% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show significant positive correlation with RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO MoM < -2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain disruptions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 2% does not correlate with subsequent equity valuation increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS MoM > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent consumer spending increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% QoQ signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with subsequent recessionary conditions.
